assets.name: rtg-edge-paint
assets.productionBrief: Production material for the approved painted RTG Edge. A 3:1 rectangular full-bleed oil-brush texture, with no interface, icons, lips, lettering, border, scenery or rounded corners. Midnight navy at 0–20%, deep forest at 20–38%, warm ivory at 40–60%, burgundy at 64–82%, antique ochre at 84–100%. Fine brush bristles diagonally upward right, calm lightness within the five icon zones. No synthetic gradient or metallic chrome.

assets.name: rtg-edge-garden
assets.productionBrief: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production asset extraction from the approved RTG Edge concept board, reference image 1. Recreate ONLY the painterly Mediterranean garden illustration shown on the LEFT side of the lower-left menu panel. Warm sunlit old ivory stone arch with closed green wooden door on the far left, pink/burgundy bougainvillea draped overhead, weathered terracotta pot and bowl of lemons near the bottom, distant quiet blue sea and green mountain coast through the right side, a soft deep-forest brush stroke in the bottom-left corner. Refined oil painting texture, antique ivory light, burgundy flowers, forest foliage, midnight blue sea, subtle ochre stones. A single full-bleed vertical 2:3 artwork, without any UI, text, words, lips, logos, menus, border, frame or rounded corners. Preserve the specific visual mood and composition of that menu illustration; do NOT return the whole concept board or a screenshot. This will be decorative art alongside live readable navigation.
